title: Fixed-Point Multiplier
statement: Implement a fixed-point multiplier that multiplies two signed 8-bit values and produces a 16-bit signed product. The module must preserve two’s complement behavior across the full range. This block is used in DSP datapaths for fractional arithmetic.
module_signature: module fixed_point_multiplier(input signed [7:0] a, input signed [7:0] b, output signed [15:0] product);
behavior: product = a * b with signed two’s complement semantics.
Avoid sequential storage in the multiplier logic.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use clocked registers or behavioral saturation.
hint: Treat the inputs as signed and use full-width product arithmetic.
